<!doctype html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover" />
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#170b10" />
  <meta name="description" content="Una sorpresa de aniversario de Luis para Cristal." />
  <title>Para Cristal ♡ — Luis · 3 años</title>
  <style>
:root{
  --bg:#fbf6f3;
  --bg-soft:#f3e7e8;
  --paper:#fffdfa;
  --paper-2:#fff8f6;
  --ink:#2a171e;
  --muted:#785f68;
  --wine:#771c34;
  --wine-2:#a43b59;
  --rose:#d9a4ae;
  --rose-soft:#eed8dc;
  --gold:#b58a5a;
  --night:#170b10;
  --line:rgba(92,31,50,.14);
  --line-strong:rgba(92,31,50,.22);
  --shadow:0 28px 70px rgba(68,22,37,.10);
  --serif:"Iowan Old Style","Palatino Linotype","Book Antiqua",Palatino,Georgia,serif;
  --sans:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;background:var(--bg)}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility}
body.is-locked{overflow:hidden}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit}
button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(164,59,89,.30);outline-offset:3px}
img{max-width:100%}
.sr-only{position:absolute!important;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity .75s ease,transform .75s cubic-bezier(.2,.72,.2,1)}
.reveal.is-visible{opacity:1;transform:none}

.reading-progress{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:3px;z-index:150;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);pointer-events:none}
.reading-progress span{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--wine),#d17b92);box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(209,123,146,.26)}

.floating-header{position:fixed;z-index:120;left:50%;top:12px;transform:translate(-50%,-150%);width:min(92vw,820px);min-height:50px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:9px 14px;border:1px solid rgba(100,30,52,.12);border-radius:20px;background:rgba(255,252,249,.88);box-shadow:0 12px 45px rgba(71,17,35,.08);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);transition:transform .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.floating-header.is-visible{transform:translate(-50%,0)}
.floating-header__identity{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;color:var(--wine);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap}
.floating-header__identity span{font-size:19px;line-height:1}
.floating-header__progress{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-width:0}
.floating-header__progress i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:999px;background:#dfcdd1;transition:width .28s ease,background .28s ease}
.floating-header__progress i.active{width:22px;background:var(--wine)}
.floating-header__chapter{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}

.audio-dock{position:fixed;z-index:125;right:16px;bottom:16px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:40px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:10px;align-items:center;max-width:min(270px,calc(100vw - 32px));padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);border-radius:19px;background:rgba(25,10,15,.93);color:white;box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(22,4,10,.22);transform:translateY(160%);transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);cursor:pointer}
.audio-dock.is-visible{transform:translateY(0)}
body.is-final .floating-header{transform:translate(-50%,-150%)}
body.is-final .audio-dock{transform:translateY(160%)}
.audio-dock__disc{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,#f8dbe2 0 8%,#411722 9% 21%,#8d2140 22% 25%,#241016 26% 100%);animation:spin 6s linear infinite;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.audio-dock.is-paused .audio-dock__disc{animation-play-state:paused}
.audio-dock__disc i{font-style:normal;font-size:11px;opacity:.88}
.audio-dock__copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;min-width:0;text-align:left}
.audio-dock__copy small{font-size:9px;opacity:.58}
.audio-dock__copy b{font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:132px}
.audio-dock__action{font-size:10px;opacity:.72}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(1turn)}}

.opening{position:fixed;z-index:200;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:auto;background:var(--night);color:white;transition:opacity .8s ease,visibility .8s ease}
.opening.is-open{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.opening__ambient{position:absolute;inset:-8%;background:url('data:image/webp;base64,') center/cover no-repeat;filter:blur(38px) saturate(.72) brightness(.65);transform:scale(1.12);opacity:.70}
.opening__veil{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 12%,rgba(154,54,83,.08),transparent 35%),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(19,6,11,.25),rgba(19,6,11,.86) 77%,#14070c 100%)}
.opening__content{position:relative;z-index:2;width:min(92vw,560px);padding:32px 0 28px;text-align:center}
.opening__date{margin-bottom:16px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.65}
.opening-photo{position:relative;margin:0 auto;width:min(86vw,430px);aspect-ratio:4/3;overflow:hidden;border-radius:32px;background:#29141d;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.19);box-shadow:0 34px 72px rgba(0,0,0,.34)}
.opening-photo::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;box-shadow:inset 0 -90px 80px -58px rgba(10,3,6,.74);pointer-events:none}
.opening-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;object-fit:contain}
.opening-photo figcaption{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:0;right:0;bottom:14px;margin:0;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.04em;opacity:.86}
.opening__copy{margin:24px auto 19px;padding:0 12px}
.eyebrow{margin:0 0 9px;color:var(--wine-2);font-size:10px;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase}
.eyebrow--light{color:#e8aabc}
.opening h1,.scene-heading h2,.promise h2,.finale__copy h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.opening h1{margin:0;font-size:clamp(43px,12vw,70px);line-height:.89}
.opening h1 em{font-weight:400;color:#f2bdca}
.opening__copy>p:last-child{margin:15px 0 0;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;opacity:.72}
.press-to-open{position:relative;display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:58px auto;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:64px;padding:4px 9px 4px 0;border:0;background:transparent;color:white;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
.press-to-open__meter{position:absolute;left:0;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.24);overflow:hidden;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025)}
.press-to-open__meter i{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#cd6682,#8f2341);transition:height .035s linear}
.press-to-open__heart{position:relative;width:56px;height:56px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:27px}
.press-to-open__text{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.press-to-open__text b{font-size:13px}.press-to-open__text small{margin-top:2px;font-size:10px;opacity:.60}
.opening__hint{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:10px;opacity:.42}

.scene{position:relative;padding:116px 20px;overflow:hidden}
.container{width:min(100%,900px);margin:auto}.container--narrow{width:min(100%,700px)}.container--wide{width:min(100%,1060px)}
.scene-heading{max-width:700px}
.scene-heading--center{text-align:center;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
.scene-heading--split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:48px;align-items:end;max-width:none}
.scene-heading h2{margin:0;font-size:clamp(48px,9vw,78px);line-height:.93}
.scene-heading h2 em,.promise h2 em,.finale__copy h2 em{font-weight:400;color:var(--wine)}
.scene-heading__lead,.scene-heading__aside{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(18px,3.6vw,23px);line-height:1.56;color:#60444e}
.scene-heading__lead{margin:22px 0 0;max-width:640px}.scene-heading--center .scene-heading__lead{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
.scene-heading__aside{margin:0;font-size:18px}

.scene--origin{padding-top:140px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% -20%,#fff 0,transparent 45%),linear-gradient(180deg,#fffaf8,var(--bg-soft))}
.scene--origin::after{content:"";position:absolute;width:360px;height:360px;border:1px solid rgba(118,29,52,.08);border-radius:50%;right:-190px;top:110px}
.timepiece{margin:42px 0 28px;padding:26px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:30px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.70);box-shadow:var(--shadow);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.timepiece__intro{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-bottom:18px;font-family:var(--serif)}
.timepiece__intro span{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}.timepiece__intro b{font-size:18px;font-weight:500}
.timepiece__grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:8px}
.timepiece__grid>div{min-width:0;padding:12px 4px;border-radius:17px;background:#fff;text-align:center;border:1px solid rgba(118,29,52,.06)}
.timepiece__grid strong{display:block;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(25px,6vw,38px);font-weight:500;line-height:1;color:var(--wine)}
.timepiece__grid small{display:block;margin-top:6px;font-size:8px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.10em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.timepiece__seconds{background:var(--wine)!important}.timepiece__seconds strong,.timepiece__seconds small{color:white!important}
.soft-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:0;padding:10px 0;border:0;background:none;color:var(--wine);font-weight:800;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer}.soft-link span{font-size:18px;transition:transform .2s}.soft-link:hover span{transform:translateY(3px)}

.scene--story{background:var(--paper)}
.scene--story::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;width:1px;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(transparent,var(--line) 15%,var(--line) 85%,transparent);opacity:.8}
.memory-timeline{display:grid;gap:24px;margin-top:58px;position:relative}
.memory-entry{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.08fr) minmax(0,.92fr);overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:34px;background:rgba(255,253,250,.96);box-shadow:0 22px 60px rgba(69,24,39,.07)}
.memory-entry--note{grid-template-columns:180px 1fr;min-height:270px}
.memory-entry__visual{min-height:370px;border-radius:0}
.photo-stage{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#2c1820}.photo-stage__blur{position:absolute;inset:-12%;background:center/cover no-repeat;filter:blur(30px) brightness(.72) saturate(.82);transform:scale(1.12);opacity:.88}.photo-stage img{position:relative;z-index:2;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;object-fit:contain}
.memory-entry__symbol{display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#f0dce0,#ead1d7);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:58px;color:rgba(118,29,52,.35)}
.memory-entry__content{align-self:center;padding:34px 36px}
.memory-entry__meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-bottom:12px}.memory-entry__meta span{display:grid;place-items:center;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--wine);color:white;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:13px}.memory-entry__meta small{font-size:9px;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--wine-2)}
.memory-entry h3{margin:0 0 13px;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(30px,5vw,42px);font-weight:500;line-height:1.03;letter-spacing:-.03em}.memory-entry p{margin:0;color:#694d57;line-height:1.65;font-size:15px}
.disclosure{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;width:100%;margin-top:22px;padding:13px 0;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:none;color:var(--wine);font-weight:800;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}.disclosure i{font-style:normal;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:22px;transition:transform .28s ease}.memory-entry.is-open .disclosure i{transform:rotate(45deg)}
.disclosure-panel{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .35s ease}.disclosure-panel p{overflow:hidden;padding-top:0;opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s ease,padding-top .25s ease}.memory-entry.is-open .disclosure-panel{grid-template-rows:1fr}.memory-entry.is-open .disclosure-panel p{padding-top:8px;opacity:1}

.scene--album{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--bg-soft),#f7eff0)}
.album-shell{margin-top:44px}
.album-stage{display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px minmax(0,1fr) 52px;align-items:center;gap:16px;max-width:850px;margin:auto;outline:none}
.album-photo{position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-width:0;aspect-ratio:4/3;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);border-radius:34px;background:#24151b;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(75,25,42,.15)}
.album-photo__blur{position:absolute;inset:-12%;background:url('data:image/webp;base64,
